meta.title: Two withdrawals of the same invoice sent in the same block
meta.breaks: ft_withdraw is a chain of five receipts. A guard that marks the invoice paid only in its callback lets a second pay of the same invoice start a second withdrawal before the first one finishes.
meta.expected_safe_result: exactly one withdrawal of 200 toward ada's destination; the second pay is refused (the invoice is already in flight)
meta.author: hand-written for the withdraw suite (Arena, 2026-11-11)
